verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site directly claims this capability: "AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients — so you can approve and pay in seconds," which covers both AI extraction of payment details and a user review/approval step before paying. The evidence is a single marketing line rather than in-depth documentation. missing for 10: detailed docs on bill intake (email forwarding vs upload) and which fields are extracted, documentation of the review/approval workflow for AI-populated bills, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.
